details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 1 - The Recruits · Seat 4, Ranged

A white-haired Nu'Dravi who struck a bargain with the Queen of Air and Darkness, and throws purple eldritch force like she was born to it. Poised, sardonic and hard to read; she is comfortable in the dark in ways that make the others uneasy. The Keepers ask fewer questions than anyone else, which suits her perfectly.

Tonight: Her first proper job for the Keepers, and the dark under a mountain feels like home.

In a fight

Hang back and Eldritch Blast every turn (Reflex DC 13; 1d6+2 on a failure). Daze the goblin who matters, drop Sleep on a pack before it reaches you, and Fey Step out of reach.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities

Eldritch Blast. At will, 60ft, one creature: Reflex save DC 13. On a failure 1d6+2 force (+2 from Cantrip Mastery); on a success half of 1d6. Never uses a slot.

Spell Use. Arcane caster, Charisma-based, save DC 13. Two 1st-level slots a day (1, +1 for Charisma 13+), back after a long rest. You know Faerie Fire (Path spell) and Sleep. No spell attack rolls: harmful spells call for a save. Any armour or shield blocks your casting. Her staff is her focus.

Fey Step (Path of the Fey). Once per round, teleport up to 10ft to an unoccupied space you can see as part of your movement.

Dark Gift (The Queen of Air and Darkness). Darkness you create is impenetrable to all sight, darkvision included. You see perfectly in any darkness, magical or mundane.

Pact. A Warlock holds the patron's alignment, so her Allegiance is the Queen's, whatever her Outlook.

Nu'Dravi. Speed 30ft, darkvision 120ft. Immune to magical sleep. Advantage on saves against charm, and on Perception by sight or hearing in low light or darkness. Trance: 4 hours' rest.

Innate magic. Dancing Lights at will. Once a day, Darkness (20ft radius, 1 round at her level) or Faerie Fire (Reflex save, DC 13).

Sunlight. She follows no faith: Disadvantage on attacks and sight-based Perception for the first hour of direct sunlight each day.

Cantrip Mastery (1st, Arcane & Devout). Two extra cantrips (Daze, Mage Hand). Once per round, add your Charisma modifier (+2) to a cantrip's damage when it hits or the target fails its save.

Casting

Eldritch Blast (cantrip): 60ft, one creature, Reflex DC 13; 1d6+2 force on a failure (Cantrip Mastery), half of 1d6 on a success.

Daze (cantrip, Cantrip Mastery): 60ft, one humanoid of Level 4 or lower is Stunned for 1 round; Will negates, and it is then immune to your Daze for the encounter.

Mage Hand (cantrip, Cantrip Mastery): 30ft, 1 minute; an invisible hand moves an unattended object of up to 5 lb at 15ft a round.

Faerie Fire (1st, Path spell): 60ft, 20ft radius, 1 minute; creatures are outlined, lose Invisible and concealment, and attacks against them have Advantage; Reflex negates.

Sleep (1st): 90ft, 15ft radius; 2d4+1 Levels of creatures fall Unconscious for 1d4 minutes, lowest Level first; Will negates, damage wakes them, and Level 5+, undead and constructs are unaffected.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 2 (Dex); no armour or shield (Warlocks are trained in none, and wearing any blocks casting) = 12

Class Abilities

1st Level

Eldritch Blast

  • Effect: At-will ranged cantrip (60ft range). The target makes a Reflex save (DC = 10 + half your Warlock level (minimum 1) + Cha modifier), taking force damage on a failure or half on a success. No slot required.
  • Damage scales: 1d6 at 1st, 1d8 at 5th, 2d6 at 9th, 3d8 at 13th, 4d8 at 17th, 5d8 at 21st. From 17th level, Eldritch Blast fires two blasts, at the same creature or different ones within range, each with its own save; Agonising Blast adds to only one of them each round.

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast arcane spells using your slots. Each time you unlock a slot level you gain two spells of that level: your Path spell (see Patron Paths) and one spell of your choice from the Warlock list in Spellcasting in Arneyan. You may cast any spell you know with any slot of its level or higher. Slots are shared with Pact Summons — see Spell Slot Progression above.

Dark Gift

  • Effect: A benefit granted by your specific patron Kit (see the Patron Paths section). A Dark Gift that adds damage or defence works only while your Warlock level is at least half your character level.

Patron Favour

  • Effect: Your patron's powers share one pool of favour: 1 use a day at 1st level, 2 at 4th and 3 at 8th. Spend a use on any Dark Gift, Patron's Mark or Patron Feature you have unlocked that costs Patron Favour; a power that is always on or passive costs nothing.

2nd Level

Eldritch Invocations

  • Effect: Choose one invocation from the list below. Choose another at 5th, 6th, 9th, 13th and 17th level. You cannot take the same invocation twice.
  • Agonising Blast: add your Charisma modifier to Eldritch Blast damage.
  • Repelling Blast: a creature of Large size or smaller hit by Eldritch Blast is pushed 10ft for each blast that hits it.
  • Armour of Shadows: +2 AC while you wear no armour and carry no shield (+3 from 10th level). Does not stack with other unarmoured bonuses of the same kind.
  • Fiendish Vigour: once per day, as part of your action, gain temporary hit points equal to your Warlock level. They last until your next long rest.
  • Mask of Many Faces: cast Change Self at will.
  • Devil's Sight: see normally in darkness, magical or otherwise, to 60ft.

3rd Level

Pact Summons

  • Effect: Your patron sends a servant. Every summons expends a slot of the creature's tier (Tier 1 = 1st level, Tier 2 = 2nd, Tier 3 = 3rd). A ritual summons takes 10 minutes and lasts 1 hour; a combat summons uses your action and lasts 1 minute. Full stat blocks are in Monsters & Treasure, but summons use the stats in your patron's Shared Summons table, not the Bestiary's. Tier 1 servants have double the HP and damage dice of their stat blocks, and the table below already shows them doubled.
  • The creature does not roll initiative: it acts immediately after you each round, moving and taking one action (all its listed attacks together count as that action). It obeys your spoken commands; with none, it attacks the nearest visible enemy
  • One summon active at a time. It departs when its duration ends, when you dismiss it with a word or when slain; a slain summon cannot be called again until you finish a long rest
  • If you fall unconscious, your summon only defends itself until you wake or it departs

4th Level

  • Patron's Mark: a minor ability from your patron. Defined by your Kit
  • Patron Favour: 2 uses a day

7th Level

Dark Harvest

  • Effect: Once per encounter, when you reduce a creature to 0 HP or below, recover one expended spell slot of a level up to half that creature's Level (rounded up, minimum 1st level). It must be a hostile creature that attacked you or an ally this encounter and was not Restrained, Paralysed, Unconscious or otherwise helpless, and never one summoned, created or controlled by you or your allies.
  • Example: kill a Level 6 creature, recover up to a 3rd level slot

8th Level

  • Patron Feature: a stronger active ability from your patron. Defined by your Kit
  • Patron Favour: 3 uses a day

10th Level

Patron's Whisper

  • Effect: During a long rest, commune directly with your patron to ask one yes/no question. The answer is always truthful — though the patron's understanding of truth may not align with yours.

15th Level

Pact Summons (Tier 4)

  • Effect: Your patron's most powerful servant becomes available. Tier 4 summons expend a 5th level slot, whether ritual or combat.
  • Charisma Bonus: gain a permanent +1 to Charisma. This increases the DC of your spells and abilities, and all Charisma-based checks

20th Level

Patron Surge

  • Effect: Once per day, cast a spell one level above your current maximum. You take 1d6 unavoidable damage per level of the surge — this cannot be reduced by any means.
  • At 20th level your maximum is 6th level. Choose one 7th-level Wizard spell as your Patron Surge: once per day you can cast it without a slot, taking 7d6 damage yourself. The patron's power always has a price

24th Level

Eldritch Master

  • Effect: Once per day, spend 1 minute communing with your patron to immediately recover all expended spell slots. The patron always wants something in return — the GM determines the cost narratively.

Patron Paths

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Warlock folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • Choose a Path at character creation. Each Path grants a passive, its own base spell list, and a shared summon pool. Kits within each Path define your Dark Gift, Patron's Mark, and Patron Feature.

Path of the Infernal

The Nine Hells run on hierarchy, contracts, and hellfire. Every devil serves the chain above them. Every Infernal Warlock serves that chain whether they know it or not.

  • Path Passive — Hellfire Affinity: Resistance 5 to fire damage. Treat all 1s on fire damage dice as 2s.

Path Spells

  • One Path spell per slot level, gained when that slot level is unlocked (alongside your chosen Warlock-list spell of the same level). Cast it with any slot of that level or higher; a Path spell is always treated as the slot level shown in the table, even where the Master list gives it a different level. Slots are shared with summoning — a slot spent on a summon cannot also be used to cast.

items.name: The Queen of Air and Darkness (Warlock)

system.description:
Ruler of the Unseelie Court. She has no face — only the dark behind it. Her Warlocks carry her cold and her silence wherever they go.

  • Dark Gift (1st): Darkness you create is impenetrable to all sight, including darkvision. You see perfectly within any darkness, magical or mundane.
  • Patron's Mark (4th): For 1 Patron Favour, step into a shadow within 10ft and emerge from any other shadow within 60ft as part of your movement. Requires existing shadows — distinct from Fey Step.
  • Patron Feature (8th): For 1 Patron Favour, wrap one creature within 60ft in Unseelie shadow for 1 minute — blinded, speed halved, all saves at disadvantage. Will save against your Class Save DC, to resist; repeat check each turn.

Allegiance: Chaotic Evil, the patron's alignment. Lore: Queen of Air and Darkness in the World of Arneyan wiki.
